publicPreviewSummary: Practice reading charts, finding patterns and using simple data to make better everyday decisions.
capstone: A short decision memo and accessible evidence chart built from a synthetic small-business dataset

modules.learningObjective: Choose answerable questions and check small everyday data tables
levelTitles: Read a Small Sales Table Accurately
Define an Answerable Everyday Data Question
Distinguish Categorical and Numeric Columns
Check Missing Transactions Before Analysis
Calculate a Meaningful Simple Comparison
Checkpoint: Clean and Explain a Data Question

modules.learningObjective: Read fair charts, explain units and calculate simple changes without overclaiming
levelTitles: Choose a Chart for a Monthly Trend
Read Axis Labels and Measurement Units
Recognize a Misleading Truncated Axis
Compute Change Between Two Periods
Spot Seasonal Patterns Without Overclaiming
Checkpoint: Describe a Chart with Evidence

modules.learningObjective: Compare outcomes, uncertainty and trade-offs before recommending actions
levelTitles: Tell Correlation from a Supported Cause
Interpret a Metric with a Small Sample
Compare Two Options with Different Trade-Offs
Use Context Before Recommending an Action
Identify What Evidence Is Still Missing
Checkpoint: Write a Balanced Insight Statement
modules.exampleScenario: Compare Two Options with Different Trade-Offs

modules.moduleTitle: Data-backed decision memo and dashboard capstone
modules.learningObjective: Explain supported findings with evidence and a reversible recommendation
levelTitles: Choose a Practical Business Decision
Summarize Two Reliable Source Tables
Create an Accessible Evidence Chart
List Assumptions and Sources of Uncertainty
Recommend One Reversible Next Step
Capstone: Deliver a Data-Based Decision Brief
